answer_1.quote: We verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework on a dialogue relation extraction task and a response generation task.

answer_2.quote: We set the decoding beam size as 5 and adopt BLEU-1/2/3/4 and Distinct-1/2 as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: Following , we ask annotators who study linguistics to evaluate model outputs from four aspects, which are fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall performance.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate model outputs from four aspects: fluency, coherence, informativeness, and overall performance
